weatherAssist.title: Auto-fill from weather
weatherAssist.farmNote: Using the saved point for {{farm}} — the farm's own location, not where this phone is. The farm's weather is what matters for the field.
weatherAssist.sharedNote: Using your shared location ({{label}}). Change it from the home screen if needed.
weatherAssist.phoneNote: Using this phone's position. If you are not standing at the farm, the weather may not match the field.
weatherAssist.filled_one: Filled {{count}} field — you can edit these
weatherAssist.filled_other: Filled {{count}} fields — you can edit these
weatherAssist.noneFilled: No matching form fields were auto-filled from this reading.
weatherAssist.errorUnavailable: The weather service is unavailable right now. Auto-fill is off — type the values manually and the prediction still works.
weatherAssist.errorFetch: Could not fetch weather for that location.
weatherAssist.errorLocation: Location is unavailable. Enter a place name instead.
weatherAssist.errorShortName: Type at least 2 characters of a place name.
